history: always-repro'd across v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607 (all 20 releases probed linearly, no invalid probes); the SPIR-V half of the same captures compiles in 19 of 20, v1.5.2010 onward -- only v1.4.1907 lacks SPIR-V codegen. Predates the 2020-12 report
summary: DXIL still rejects an empty payload struct while SPIR-V compiles it, unchanged on every measurable build (v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607 and main). The DXIL diagnostic misnames its cause: it says the shader must include an inout payload structure parameter, but the parameter is present and what CGHLSLMS.cpp:2492 checks is payloadSizeInBytes == 0 -- a payload whose only member is an empty struct gets the same message, and since PR #5131 (2023-04) a genuinely missing parameter gets an accurate Sema message instead. Whether an empty payload should be legal is a language/product decision, deliberate since 2018 and still unanswered on the thread; the wrong message is separately fixable either way.
title: Empty Payload struct not recognized in DXIL
